Verdict: needs_changes. Implementer target declaration is correct (`Repo: DontPanic`, `Env: dev`, `Project: (none)`), and `target_context.commands_run` contains only pytest commands with no forbidden shapes.

FINDING (medium, correctness): Per-project build warnings are double-counted. Evidence: `projects_dashboard.build_project_state()` appends warnings in the `warn` callback passed to `dashboard.build()` and then appends `build_report.warnings` again afterward at `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/projects_dashboard.py:280` and `:294`, so `build-warnings.json` and fleet `warning_count` can duplicate every dashboard warning. Recommendation: either let `dashboard.build()` own warning collection and only extend from `build_report.warnings`, or pass through warnings without appending locally.

Checks run:
$ PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=../scripts pytest -p no:cacheprovider ../scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_projects_dashboard_f001.py -q

That pytest command could not start because this read-only sandbox has no usable temporary directory. Read-only import sanity passed:
